source_policy: Freshly authored from approved MVP and current use-case specifications; no prior diagrams read or imported.
layout: Deterministic lane-aware rows with obstacle-aware orthogonal grid routing; Graphviz unavailable.
style: Built-in default palette; Helvetica 14 actions/decisions and 16 titles; minimal blue actions, yellow decisions, grey exceptions; semantic legend included. Full action/guard details remain in node detail fields and semantic notes.

diagrams.title: U7 — Propose/Withdraw Full Refund
semantic_notes: Propose requires no other PENDING proposal; withdraw requires original proposer and still-PENDING status.
A PENDING refund proposal freezes seller delivery recording and buyer release. Withdrawal or refusal restores otherwise eligible actions without rolling back saved delivery.
Full amount to original funding source only; no payment instruction until counterparty approval.
A competing approval/dispute wins atomically; dispute invalidates the proposal.

diagrams.title: U8 — Accept/Reject Refund Proposal

Acceptance/withdrawal/dispute race: first valid transition wins.
Refusal restores otherwise eligible seller delivery recording and buyer release without rolling back saved delivery.
FAILED requires authoritative proof that no money moved; uncertainty does not permit retry.
Approved Refund permanently locks direction; no later participant release/dispute.
